results.name: Wrong-recipient recovery (bKash)
results.planText:
Practical next steps
Private · offline

This private plan is generated locally from the selected situation and categorical comparison states. It does not send your note or transaction details anywhere.

WHAT REMAINS UNKNOWN
No screenshot comparison has been recorded. This is optional and is not provider verification.
RECOMMENDED NEXT STEPS
DO NOW
Contact the payment provider through its official app or website promptly and ask it to review the transaction.

Only the provider can assess its own transaction records and available remedy.

NEXT
Keep the original message, receipt and reference as received; record when you contacted official support and any ticket reference.

A factual timeline helps you explain the issue without inventing missing details.

IF UNRESOLVED
If the provider does not resolve the case, follow its formal complaint process and then check the regulator’s official escalation procedure.

The applicable process depends on the provider and circumstances; no outcome is guaranteed.

AVOID
Do not pay anyone promising guaranteed recovery, and do not share PINs or OTPs.
COMPLAINT BRIEF CHECKLIST
Describe the transaction and issue using facts you personally verified.
List what evidence is attached and mark any missing or unverified field as unknown.
Ask the provider to review its records and provide a complaint/ticket reference.

Offline guidance, not an AI finding or a verified financial conclusion. Confirm important facts through official channels.
